 View Count 
 Enlarge image 
 Disney+ original series "The Remarried Empress" has unveiled steel cuts for episodes 7 and 8, previewing an unpredictable plot driven by intricately intertwined relationships and a series of explosive events. 
 "The Remarried Empress" is a romance fantasy epic that unfolds as Navier (played by Shin Min-a), the flawless empress of the Eastern Empire, receives a notice of divorce from Emperor Sovieshu (played by Ju Ji-hoon), who has fallen for the runaway slave Rashta (played by Lee Se-young). Instead of accepting the divorce, Navier demands approval for her remarriage to Heinrey (played by Lee Jong-suk), a prince of the Western Kingdom. 
 The steel cuts released on the 18th evoke pity by capturing a sorrowful expression on Navier, who has previously maintained an unshakeable and solid composure in any situation. As her deepened wounds and shaken emotions are conveyed raw, the sight of Heinrey looking at Navier with affectionate eyes adds a flutter of excitement. In particular, Heinrey's direct question, "Do you love your husband?", draws intense attention to what kind of changes it will bring to Navier, whose relationship with Sovieshu has gone awry. 
 The confrontation between new characters shaking up the imperial family also raises tension to its peak. With the appearance of Koshar (played by Ha Do-kwon), Navier's older brother and commander of the Northern Command, a sharp current flows through the imperial court. The tense standoff between Koshar and Sovieshu, who do not hide their discomfort toward each other, foreshadows an unusual collision. Curiosity is stimulated as to what actions Koshar, having witnessed his beloved younger sister Navier getting hurt, will take against Sovieshu and his mistress Rashta. 
 Enlarge image 
 In addition, a sense of crisis is detected in the relationship between Viscount Loteschu (played by Park Ho-san) and Rashta. With the covert meeting between Madame Albani (played by Jung Young-joo) and Loteschu also captured, curiosity is amplified as to whether the secret of Rashta's past, which she has desperately hidden, will rise to the surface. Attention is focused on what choices Rashta, who has grown her desires to protect her position, will make amidst the tightening pressure. 
 Meanwhile, episodes 7 and 8 of "The Remarried Empress," which continue to maintain global box office momentum with crossed love, desires, and deepening conflicts, will be released today, the 18th, on Disney+.
